biography.plain_text: Filippo Marazzi was an Italian ceramics industrialist who expanded his family's Sassuolo-based tile manufacturer internationally. After taking control following his father's death, he established production operations in Spain and the United States. The grandson of the company's founder, he remained its chairman and controlling shareholder until his death in 2012.

long_biography.plain_text:
Italian ceramics industrialist Filippo Marazzi opened Il Crogiolo as a place for artistic and technical experimentation within his company. Established during the 1980s, the research centre brought artists, architects and designers into the development of ceramic surfaces. The centre occupied the company's original factory building, giving the old industrial space a new creative purpose.

Marazzi's interest in materials also extended to industrial research. The University of Modena awarded him an honorary degree in chemistry in 1992 for his work promoting the study of ceramics. Within the business, investment in research produced Enduro, a tile developed to withstand harder use through a new glazing process.
